packageRules.description: oxlint-tsgolint is hard-pinned to a TypeScript patch release (7.0.2002 means 'tsgolint patch 2 for TypeScript 7.0.2'). Bumping one without the other breaks type-aware linting.
oxfmt is pre-1.0 with no semver protection on output, so a bump can reformat the whole repo. That diff must never be tangled with a logic change.
Eight quality gates are what make unattended merges safe.
